GoalOptions.Label: Technical Blueprint
GoalOptions.Text: To serve as the definitive technical blueprint for the intelligent, event-driven Predictive Resource Scaling & Optimization system. This document will guide Junior Devs and DevOps in the accurate implementation and operationalization of all components, ensuring adherence to architectural principles and non-functional requirements.

GoalOptions.Label: Implementation Guide
GoalOptions.Text: To provide a comprehensive implementation guide for the Predictive Resource Scaling & Optimization system, detailing the design of each service (Data Ingestion, Prediction Engine, Resource Orchestration). The goal is to enable Junior Devs to develop robust, scalable, and maintainable code, and DevOps to establish efficient deployment and monitoring pipelines.

GoalOptions.Label: Performance & Cost Optimization
GoalOptions.Text: To outline the detailed design choices that ensure the Predictive Resource Scaling & Optimization system achieves its critical non-functional targets. This includes specifying mechanisms for real-time scaling decisions, maintaining prediction accuracy, and delivering the projected 15-25% annual cloud spend reduction, crucial for both development and operational teams.

GoalOptions.Label: System Specification
GoalOptions.Text: To formally specify the architecture, component interactions, and data flows of the event-driven Predictive Resource Scaling & Optimization system. This document aims to ensure all stakeholders, from Senior Engineers to Junior Devs and DevOps, possess a shared, unambiguous understanding of the system's technical design and operational requirements.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical & Performance Focus
Criteria: All services (Data Ingestion, Prediction Engine, Resource Orchestration) are clearly defined with their APIs, data contracts, and event structures.
The design explicitly addresses how real-time scaling decisions will be made within 5 minutes.
Mechanisms for achieving and monitoring >90% prediction accuracy for critical resources are detailed.
Scalability and resilience strategies for handling varying data ingestion rates and prediction loads are documented.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Operational & Cost Focus
Criteria: Deployment strategies for each service, including containerization and orchestration, are specified for DevOps.
Monitoring, logging, and alerting requirements for system health and performance are comprehensively outlined.
The design includes specific optimizations and resource allocation strategies to achieve 15-25% annual cloud spend reduction.
Runbook procedures or operational guidelines for common scenarios (e.g., model retraining, service failure) are referenced or detailed.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Architectural & Maintainability Focus
Criteria: The document clearly maps design decisions to the overall event-driven architecture principles.
Modularity and extensibility of each service are demonstrated, allowing for future enhancements or model updates.
Security considerations for data ingestion, processing, and resource orchestration are addressed.
Code organization, testing strategies, and documentation standards for Junior Devs are implicitly or explicitly supported by the design.
